Transportation & Infrastructure | U.S. Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon <span id="docs-internal-guid-caf3af92-7fff-e349-d156-75fd2f74b1cc"><span>Pennsylvania’s 5th Congressional district is home to one of the largest transportation and infrastructure networks in the Northeast United States. However, the federal government has failed to properly invest in keeping our infrastructure in good condition, and residents of our district are paying the price. From traditional infrastructure – like roads, bridges, and ports – to other critical infrastructure like schools, waterways, and broadband, we have lagged behind our peers in ensuring we are prepared for future generations. </span></span></p> <p> </p> <p dir="ltr"><span id="docs-internal-guid-caf3af92-7fff-e349-d156-75fd2f74b1cc"><span>Congresswoman Scanlon is committed to supporting bipartisan solutions to fund the bold transportation and infrastructure investments Pennsylvania so desperately needs.</span></span></p>" /> Skip to Content Transportation & Infrastructure Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Pennsylvania’s 5th Congressional district is home to one of the largest transportation and infrastructure networks in the Northeast United States. However, the federal government has failed to properly invest in keeping our infrastructure in good condition, and residents of our district are paying the price. From traditional infrastructure – like roads, bridges, and ports – to other critical infrastructure like schools, waterways, and broadband, we have lagged behind our peers in ensuring we are prepared for future generations. Congresswoman Scanlon is committed to supporting bipartisan solutions to fund the bold transportation and infrastructure investments Pennsylvania so desperately needs. Education & Labor | U.S. Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon The challenges of our education system are a critical issue for Pennsylvanians and students across the country. </p> <p dir="ltr"><span id="docs-internal-guid-73b27bd0-7fff-2a49-c523-3c1da384e6a3"><span>Congresswoman Scanlon is a longtime education rights advocate who believes that all students should have access to quality education and post-secondary opportunities. She believes that our investments in education should give the next generation the best opportunity to succeed. Congresswoman Scanlon believes in addressing the challenges of our education system must begin with expanding access to early childhood education. She supports policy measures that fairly fund our schools, which include resources that support our teachers and counselors, safe and inclusive learning environments, fully funding the IDEA and Title I. </span></span></p> <p> </p> <p dir="ltr"><span id="docs-internal-guid-73b27bd0-7fff-2a49-c523-3c1da384e6a3"><span>Congresswoman Scanlon is working to make post-secondary opportunities more affordable and accessible. She also supports expanding Career Technical Education (CTE) and apprenticeship programs so that students have the greatest number of pathways to success. Students need to know that there are jobs waiting for them on the other side of their degree or certificate programs. Investments in workforce development are critical to ensuring qualified students find rewarding jobs after graduation.</span></span></p> <p> </p> <p dir="ltr"><span id="docs-internal-guid-73b27bd0-7fff-2a49-c523-3c1da384e6a3"><span>Congresswoman Scanlon is committed to fighting for middle class families and is an ardent supporter of labor and workers rights. She is working to ensure that the right to collective bargaining is secure and established, and will continue to oppose any and all attacks on the hardworking men and women that built this country. </span></span></p>" /> Skip to Content Education & Labor Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email The challeng

Energy & Environment | U.S. Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon Climate change is one of the most serious threats facing our nation and planet, and it deserves a serious response. Changing weather patterns have immediate and long-term consequences and pose grave risks to our national security and economic stability. Remaining in the Paris Climate Agreement is step one, but we must go further to reduce carbon emissions and set ourselves on a path that provides for sustainable and affordable renewable energy. </span> <p dir="ltr"><span id="docs-internal-guid-a7979a38-7fff-64f3-2784-da3363240f7c"><span>Congresswoman Scanlon will support efforts to protect and strengthen the Clean Air Act and Clean Water Act from attacks by the Trump Administration, and help our nation return to its rightful place as a worldwide environmental protection leader.</span></span></p>" /> Skip to Content Energy & Environment Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Climate change is one of the most serious threats facing our nation and planet, and it deserves a serious response. Changing weather patterns have immediate and long-term consequences and pose grave risks to our national security and economic stability. Remaining in the Paris Climate Agreement is step one, but we must go further to reduce carbon emissions and set ourselves on a path that provides for sustainable and affordable renewable energy. Congresswoman Scanlon will support efforts to protect and strengthen the Clean Air Act and Clean Water Act from attacks by the Trump Administration, and help our nation return to its rightful place as a worldwide environmental protection leader. Healthcare | U.S. Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon <span id="docs-internal-guid-dcd89cb3-7fff-3db2-22a6-61547db9abd6"><span>Congresswoman Scanlon has taken steps to safeguard the Affordable Care Act and has co-sponsored legislation to protect its guarantees. She has also co-sponsored legislation to bring down the cost of prescription drugs by holding pharmaceutical companies responsible for their bad behavior, encouraging generic drug competition, and rethinking existing payment models so medicines are affordable for those who rely on them. </span></span></p> <p dir="ltr"><span id="docs-internal-guid-dcd89cb3-7fff-3db2-22a6-61547db9abd6"><span>Congresswoman Scanlon is also a longtime advocate and supporter of women’s reproductive rights and will fight to push back against any measure to undo the rule of law. </span></span></p>" /> Skip to Content Healthcare Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Every American deserves access to quality, affordable healthcare. No family should endure financial hardship due to the high cost of care, prescription drugs or treatment, and no one should live in fear that they will be uninsured due to a pre-existing condition. Congresswoman Scanlon has taken steps to safeguard the Affordable Care Act and has co-sponsored legislation to protect its guarantees. She has also co-sponsored legislation to bring down the cost of prescription drugs by holding pharmaceutical companies responsible for their bad behavior, encouraging generic drug competition, and rethinking existing payment models so medicines are affordable for those who rely on them. Congresswoman Scanlon is also a longtime advocate and supporter of women’s reproductive rights and will fight to push back against any measure to undo the rule of law. Common Sense Gun Safety | U.S. Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon <span id="docs-internal-guid-06479ac5-7fff-6d2a-e667-2435d8b98ed3"><span>One of the first steps Congresswoman Scanlon took in Congress was to join the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force. She has cosponsored several pieces of legislation to close loopholes, improve background checks, ban assault rifles, and also managed the debate on the House floor to reauthorize the Violence Against Women Act. </span></span></p> <p dir="ltr"><span id="docs-internal-guid-06479ac5-7fff-6d2a-e667-2435d8b98ed3"><span>“Gun violence has become a constant in our lives, invading our schools, our places of worship, and the places where we work and play -- we must make common sense gun safety legislation a priority. Students, families, and communities should not have to ask for the government to protect them. It is our responsibility to take action to reduce gun violence.” </span></span></p>" /> Skip to Content Common Sense Gun Safety Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Gun violence has grown to be the 2nd leading cause of death of children in the United States. Common sense gun safety policy has been a priority for Congresswoman Scanlon since she organized mothers in her district to join the “Mom’s March On Washington” in 2000 to demand action. One of the first steps Congresswoman Scanlon took in Congress was to join the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force. She has cosponsored several pieces of legislation to close loopholes, improve background checks, ban assault rifles, and also managed the debate on the House floor to reauthorize the Violence Against Women Act. “Gun violence has become a constant in our lives, invading our schools, our places of worship, and the places where we work and play -- we must make common sense gun safety legislation a priority. Students, families, and communities should not have to ask for the government to protect them.
